title: The Iran war has now cost America $47 billion
lines: The United States has now spent more than forty-seven billion dollars on its war with Iran, according to a new Pentagon estimate.
The figure was given to lawmakers, and reported by CBS News and Reuters. It covers costs up to mid-October.
Most of it, about twenty-nine billion dollars, is to replace missiles, bombs and interceptors used in the war.
Another six billion dollars is for equipment that was lost, including many drones.
Almost twelve billion more covers the extra costs of running the operation, such as flights and support for troops.
In July, Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth had put the cost at thirty-seven and a half billion dollars. The new figure is more than twenty-five percent higher.
And it does not include repairs to American bases in the Middle East that were hit by Iranian missiles and drones.
The Congressional Budget Office estimates that the war costs two to three billion dollars for every month it continues.
The war began in February, when the United States and Israel launched strikes on Iran. It is now in its ninth month.
Fighting has been quieter in recent weeks, but President Trump has suggested combat could resume after the midterm elections on November the third, unless Iran agrees to a deal.
The Pentagon's own inspector general has warned of shortfalls in some American weapons stocks.
